verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management/work platform, since some products in this category offer on-premise deployment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-premise, or source-available deployment of ClickUp. The pack covers only the cloud product, its Public API, its hosted MCP server, and integrations. Some integration partners, such as n8n, are self-hostable themselves, but that is a third-party product and earns no credit here.
